constraints.evidence_quote: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant. The thirty dollar ($30) application screening fee may be adjusted annually by the landlord or their agent commensurate with an increase in the Consumer Price Index, beginning on January 1, 1998.

constraints.obligation_text: Only charge the fee when a rental unit is or will within a reasonable time be available.
constraints.evidence_quote: (1) A landlord or their agent shall not charge an applicant an application screening fee when they know or should have known that no rental unit is available at that time or will be available within a reasonable period of time.

constraints.obligation_text: Give the applicant a receipt itemizing the out-of-pocket expenses and time spent, personally or by mail.
constraints.evidence_quote: The landlord or their agent shall provide, personally, or by mail, the applicant with a receipt for the fee paid by the applicant, which receipt shall itemize the out-of-pocket expenses and time spent by the landlord or their agent to obtain and process the information about the applicant.

constraints.obligation_text: Return any part of the fee not used for authorized purposes if no reference check is done or no credit report is obtained.
constraints.evidence_quote:
If the landlord or their agent does
not perform a personal reference check or does not obtain a consumer credit report, the landlord or their agent shall return any amount of the screening fee that is not used for the purposes authorized by this section to the applicant.
